1.text: Mu mwaka umwami Uziya yatanzemo, nabonye Umwami Imana yicaye ku ntebe y'ubwami ndende ishyizwe hejuru, igishura cyayo gikwira urusengero.

2.text: Abaserafi bari bahagaze hejuru yayo, umuserafi wese afite amababa atandatu. Abiri yayatwikirizaga mu maso he, yandi abiri yayatwikirizaga ibirenge bye, ayandi abiri yarayagurukishaga.

3.text: Umwe avuga ijwi rirenga abwira mugenzi we asingiza ati “Uwiteka Nyiringabo arera, arera, arera. Isi yose yuzuye icyubahiro cye.”

4.text: Imfatiro z'irebe ry'umuryango zinyeganyezwa n'ijwi ry'uwavuze ijwi rirenga, inzu yose yuzura umwotsi.

5.text: Maze ndavuga nti “Ni ishyano, ndapfuye we! Kuko ndi umunyaminwa yanduye, kandi ntuye hagati y'ubwoko bufite iminwa yanduye, kandi amaso yanjye abonye Umwami Uwiteka Nyiringabo.”

6.text: Maze umwe mu Baserafi araguruka, aza aho ndi afite ikara mu ntoki ryaka yakuje urugarama ku gicaniro,

7.text: arinkoza ku munwa arambwira ati “Dore iri rigukoze ku munwa, gukiranirwa kwawe kugukuweho, ibyaha byawe biratwikiriwe.”

8.text: Numva ijwi ry'Umwami Imana riti “Ndatuma nde, ni nde watugendera?”Maze ndavuga nti “Ni jye. Ba ari jye utuma.”

9.text: Irambwira iti “Genda ubwire ubu bwoko uti ‘Kumva muzajye mwumva, ariko mwe kubimenya, kureba muzajye mureba, ariko mwe kubyitegereza.’ 28.26-27

10.text: Ujye unangira imitima y'ubu bwoko, uhindure amatwi yabo ibihuri, upfuke amaso yabo kugira ngo batarebesha amaso, batumvisha amatwi, batamenyesha imitima, bagahindukira bagakira.”

11.text: Ndayibaza nti “Nyagasani, ibyo bizageza he?”Iransubiza iti “Bizageza aho imidugudu izabera imyirare ari nta wuyibamo, n'amazu ari nta wuyabamo, n'igihugu kigahinduka amatongo rwose,

12.text: Uwiteka akarangiza kwimurira abantu kure, kandi amatongo akaba menshi muri iki gihugu.

13.text: Kandi naho cyasigarwamo n'umugabane umwe mu icumi, na bwo kizongera gutwikwa, nk'uko ibiti by'umwela n'umwaloni bisigarana igishyitsi bimaze gucibwa, ni ko urubyaro rwera rusa n'igishyitsi cyarwo.”
